baseline.policy: Use the current broad-market price-floor, low-extension, high-volatility trend-persistence paper eligibility and score with its frozen universe, next-open clock, notional, costs and exits.

execution_envelope.capacity_constraint: At most one existing paper cash slot; positive-contribution ticker share below 40% and partner share below 50%; no portfolio allocation, production signal or order effect
execution_envelope.costs_and_carry: Repository cash-equity commission and slippage assumptions at identical notional; no financing, borrow credit or option carry
execution_envelope.intended_instrument: HALO common stock for the current lead; any future cohort remains long common equity only, with no option, leverage, inverse product, proxy or short leg
execution_envelope.liquidity_dependency: Canonical OHLCV, next-regular-session-open availability, gap-cancel, stale-price and minimum-liquidity controls must pass
execution_envelope.timing_constraint: Issuer release acceptance, effective partner-product relationships, product-sales and royalty fields, price inputs, universe membership and any independent market prior must be known before each simulated decision open

candidates.falsifier: Reject or park if no observable market prior can separate expected from surprising conversion; if partner-product relationships, sales and royalty definitions cannot be frozen effective-dated and as-known; if partner sales do not transmit to comparable HALO royalty observations; if any standard window has fewer than five executable treatment decisions; if D0-D3 finds a frozen near-neighbor; if one ticker exceeds 40% or one partner exceeds 50% of positive treatment value; or if H10 and H20 replacement value does not beat cash, SPY, QQQ and the unconditioned broad-market row after identical costs.
candidates.hypothesis: For the previously preregistered current HALO broad-market price-leadership row, when source-dated evidence known before the next decision open confirms effective named partner-product commercialization and comparable recurring HALO royalty conversion rather than only a one-off approval headline, the move may persist over fixed next-open H10 and H20 horizons; keep broad-market eligibility and score unchanged and use the condition only as a deterministic research admission tag.
candidates.replacement_value_comparator: Zero-return cash, identical-interval SPY and QQQ, and the exact unconditioned broad-market paper row at the same decision clock, notional, costs and exit policy.
candidates.title: HALO partner-product royalty-conversion continuation lead

treatment.policy: Keep broad-market eligibility and score unchanged. Attach a research admission tag only when source-dated evidence known before the decision open binds an effective HALO-to-named-partner-to-product relationship, commercialization evidence and a comparable recurring royalty-conversion observation; otherwise abstain. Evaluate fixed H10 and H20 horizons.

candidates.why_not_arbitraged: The Q2 royalty acceleration, raised guidance and partner sales were public before the frozen next-open decision. A residual edge can exist only if investors underweight the durability and capital efficiency of conversion royalties relative to one-off approval or earnings momentum, and it must survive independent market-prior, source, PIT, transmission, touch-density, novelty, concentration and exact replacement-value tests rather than rely on the issuer narrative.
